title: A new wave of Connected Apps is rolling out to Gemini.
gist: A new batch of third-party Connected Apps is rolling out inside the Gemini app across productivity (Airtable, Linear, monday.com, PandaDoc, Wispr AI, Zoho), creativity (Adobe, Picsart, Squarespace, Webflow) and lifestyle (apartments.com, Experian, Peloton, SeatGeek), positioning Gemini as a hub that replaces tab-switching.

insights.claim: The Gemini app is being positioned as a single place to manage projects, design assets and plan workouts via connected third-party apps, aiming to replace switching between browser tabs.
insights.speaker: Mai Lowe
insights.so_what: Assistant-as-front-door strategy threatens direct app engagement; watch whether partner apps become backend services behind Gemini.
insights.quote: Instead of switching between tabs, you can now manage projects, design creative assets, and plan your workouts all in one place.
insights.locator: We are bringing more of your favorite apps directly into Gemini

insights.claim: Users can invoke Gemini Connected Apps through Gemini settings, by typing an @ mention in chat, or simply by asking directly.
insights.speaker: Mai Lowe
insights.so_what: Low-friction invocation increases the likelihood that partner app usage routes through Gemini's chat interface.
insights.locator: To get started, connect your favorite apps

insights.claim: New productivity integrations in Gemini include Airtable, Linear, monday.com, PandaDoc, Wispr AI and Zoho, covering project management, databases and note dictation.
insights.speaker: Mai Lowe
insights.so_what: monday.com and peers are hedging by distributing through AI assistants; watch for engagement or seat effects from assistant-mediated usage.

insights.claim: New creativity integrations in Gemini include Adobe, Picsart, Squarespace and Webflow for designing visual assets and building websites.
insights.speaker: Mai Lowe
insights.so_what: Adobe distributing inside a rival AI assistant signals incumbents prefer presence in Gemini over walled-garden defense.

insights.claim: New lifestyle integrations in Gemini include apartments.com for apartment search, Experian for credit monitoring, Peloton for workout planning and SeatGeek for event tickets.
insights.speaker: Mai Lowe
insights.so_what: Consumer transactional categories (housing, credit, fitness, ticketing) are becoming agent-accessible, a potential shift in customer-acquisition channels for these brands.
